independenceRules: Saved versus unsaved describes draft persistence and never implies result freshness.
The activeResult field describes the current workspace result even when the user inspects another historical record.
Inspection selects which result object is foregrounded; a historical inspection never activates its Scenario or Version as the current draft.
Availability can override the primary result label while known source identity remains visible.
Unsupported quantity is a feature-level state; show it beside, not instead of, the underlying Run state when both apply.

decisionTable.visibleOutput: Run needed / explicit empty state. Do not invent a CURRENT Run.
UNAVAILABLE with reason; keep the active Scenario/Version draft cue.
actions: Refresh or rerun only when required inputs are available

decisionTable.visibleOutput: UNSUPPORTED for the selected quantity with model/profile reason.
CURRENT / Current result with source Scenario, source Version or draft source, result type, and Run.
STALE / Result out of date with original source Version, Run, and run time; map artifacts remain safely invalidated.
UNAVAILABLE for the missing result detail or artifact; preserve the known CURRENT/STALE source as technical/current-workspace context.
UNSUPPORTED for that quantity plus the underlying CURRENT or STALE result context.
HISTORICAL with source Scenario, Version, Run type/date; show current workspace Scenario/Version and draft state if different.
actions: Run again from this Run only with exact input and matching dataset

decisionTable.visibleOutput: UNAVAILABLE with reason for missing report bytes or required historical detail, retaining any known historical Scenario/Version/Run identity and current workspace distinction. A Report may legitimately have No Run.
UNSUPPORTED for the quantity; keep the historical Run/Report source visible.

planStateOverlay.saved: Header shows Project / Scenario / Version and Saved Version.
planStateOverlay.unsaved: Header shows Project / Scenario / base Version and Unsaved changes; local autosave does not create an immutable Version.
planStateOverlay.rule: Apply each plan overlay to every decision-table row. Never use saved/unsaved state as a substitute for freshness.

currentResultResolution.unknownEvidence: Unknown identity/fingerprint remains unknown; restored result without unambiguous Run is UNAVAILABLE.
currentResultResolution.draftRunSource: A Run without a retained ScenarioRevision remains draft-sourced; do not label it as belonging to the draft's base Version.
currentResultResolution.sourceVersionNavigation: Only navigate to an exact retained Version. Block Scenario activation while an unsaved current draft would be discarded; keep the working draft intact and explain that the user must save it as a Version first.
